% Status chips and zones
\newcommand{\chip}[2]{{\setlength{\fboxsep}{1.6pt}\colorbox{#1}{\color{white}\scriptsize\bfseries\strut\,#2\,}}}
\newcommand{\status}[2]{\ifstrequal{#1}{RED}{\chip{cred}{#2}}{\ifstrequal{#1}{AMBER}{\chip{camber}{#2}}{\chip{cgreen}{#2}}}}
\newcommand{\tagR}[1]{\chip{cred}{#1}}
\newcommand{\tagA}[1]{\chip{camber}{#1}}
\newcommand{\tagG}[1]{\chip{cgreen}{#1}}
\newcommand{\zone}[1]{\ifstrequal{#1}{KEEP OUT}{\chip{cred}{KEEP OUT}}{\ifstrequal{#1}{RESTRICTED}{\chip{camber}{RESTRICTED}}{\ifstrequal{#1}{SAFE}{\chip{cgreen}{SAFE}}{\chip{cgrey}{NOT SURVEYED}}}}}
\usepackage{etoolbox}

\newtcolorbox{finding}[1]{enhanced,breakable,colback=white,colframe=ink!35,boxrule=0.5pt,arc=0pt,
  left=6pt,right=6pt,top=4pt,bottom=4pt,title={#1},fonttitle=\bfseries\small,coltitle=ink,colbacktitle=paper}
\newcommand{\action}[1]{{\setlength{\fboxsep}{5pt}\colorbox{accent!35}{\parbox{\dimexpr\linewidth-10pt}{\small\textbf{Recommended action.} #1}}}}
\newcommand{\dosebar}[2]{\begin{tikzpicture}[baseline]
  \fill[ink!10] (0,0) rectangle (0.62\linewidth,6pt);
  \fill[ink] (0,0) rectangle ({0.62\linewidth*#1/100},6pt);
  \node[anchor=west,font=\footnotesize] at (0.63\linewidth,3pt) {#2};
  \end{tikzpicture}}
